mapper.select: SELECT o.*,v.raw_text FROM document_compilation_origins o JOIN document_versions v ON v.document_id=o.document_id AND v.document_version=o.document_version WHERE o.document_id=#{args[0]} AND o.document_version=#{args[1]}

SELECT * FROM document_compilation_section_bindings WHERE document_id=#{args[0]} AND document_version=#{args[1]} AND processing_revision=#{args[2]} ORDER BY start_offset,logical_section_id,parsed_section_id
SELECT * FROM compilation_save_preparations WHERE actor_user_id=#{args[0]} AND request_key=#{args[1]}
SELECT * FROM compilation_save_preparations WHERE approval_id=#{args[0]} AND actor_user_id=#{args[1]}
SELECT * FROM document_compilation_origins WHERE document_id=#{args[0]} AND document_version <= #{args[1]} ORDER BY document_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM document_compilation_sources WHERE compiled_document_id=#{args[0]} AND compiled_document_version=#{args[1]} ORDER BY source_order

SELECT DISTINCT compiled_document_id FROM document_compilation_sources s JOIN documents d ON d.id=s.compiled_document_id JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.id=d.knowledge_base_id WHERE source_document_id=#{args[0]} AND d.deleted=FALSE AND k.deleted=FALSE AND k.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY compiled_document_id LIMIT #{args[2]} OFFSET #{args[1]}
SELECT DISTINCT source_document_version FROM document_compilation_sources WHERE source_document_id=#{args[0]} AND compiled_document_id=#{args[1]} ORDER BY source_document_version
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_compilation_sources WHERE compiled_document_id=#{args[0]} OR source_document_id=#{args[0]}
DELETE FROM document_compilation_sources WHERE compiled_base_id=#{args[0]} OR source_base_id=#{args[0]}
